builds.title: Tibbit mews courier, Rogue 1
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. Cat form also has scent.
traits: Chaotic good. Humanoid form uses studded leather +3, Dexterity +3, and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 14. BAB +0, grapple −4. Fortitude +2, Reflex +5, Will +1. Armor check penalty −1. Improved Initiative adds +4.
Cat form: Tiny, STR 3, DEX 18, HP 8, AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12, initiative +8, grapple −12, Fortitude +2, Reflex +6, Will +1. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Worn armor and thieves’ tools meld.
Trapfinding and sneak attack +1d6. Search can locate traps with DC above 20. Magical traps can be disarmed with Disable Device. Pell returns to humanoid form to manipulate his tools.
Cat form cannot speak, manipulate fine objects, cast spells with verbal or somatic components, use scrolls, or activate magic items.
actions: Small dagger +1 melee, 1d3 piercing or slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, 80-ft. increment. Reload as a move action.

Cat form: claw −2 melee, 1 piercing and slashing. Full attack: two claws at −2 and bite −7 for 1 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning. All critical hits are ×2. Tiny reach requires entering the target’s space and normally provokes. The listed damage includes the minimum 1 before damage reduction.

Add 1d6 sneak attack to a qualifying attack against a target denied Dexterity to AC or when flanking with melee. Ranged sneak attack requires a target within 30 ft. The cat’s 0-ft. reach cannot flank, but it can still sneak attack a target denied Dexterity to AC.

Feline Transformation lets a Tibbit become a house cat at will as a standard action. The rules give no duration limit. Returning to humanoid form takes a full-round action. Wait one hour after returning before transforming again.
builds.tactics: Pell scouts the mews in cat form while the porter makes his rounds. He returns to humanoid form in an alcove and uses his tools to open the tack-room lock. The party can warn him if the porter returns during the change.

builds.title: Tibbit grain loft watch, Fighter 1
builds.senses: Darkvision 60 ft. Cat form also has scent.
traits: Chaotic neutral. Studded leather +3, heavy wooden shield +2, Dexterity +3, and size +1. Touch 14, flat-footed 16. BAB +1, grapple +0. Fortitude +3, Reflex +3, Will +1. Armor check penalty −3. Improved Initiative adds +4.

Cat form: Tiny, STR 8, DEX 18, HP 11, AC 16, touch 16, flat-footed 12, initiative +8, grapple −8, Fortitude +3, Reflex +4, Will +1. Space 2½ ft., reach 0 ft. Worn armor, shield, and weapons meld. Weapon Finesse uses Dexterity to hit with natural weapons.
Cat form cannot speak, manipulate fine objects, cast spells with verbal or somatic components, use scrolls, or activate magic items.
actions: Small longsword +5 melee, 1d6+3 slashing, critical 19–20/×2, 5-ft. reach. Small javelin +5 ranged, 1d4+3 piercing, critical ×2, 30-ft. increment.

Cat form: claw +7 melee, 1 piercing and slashing. Full attack: two claws at +7 and bite +2 for 1d3−1 piercing, slashing, and bludgeoning (minimum 1). All critical hits are ×2. The cat normally provokes when entering an enemy’s space to attack.

Feline Transformation lets a Tibbit become a house cat at will as a standard action. The rules give no duration limit. Returning to humanoid form takes a full-round action. Wait one hour after returning before transforming again.
builds.tactics: Rusk waits in cat form near the loft opening. He listens for movement and can use scent to pinpoint a creature within 5 ft. in the dark. If someone threatens the storekeeper, he retreats behind the sacks to spend a full round returning to humanoid form, then uses his shield and longsword.

concepts.name: Pell Fenwick
concepts.motive: Retrieve a misdelivered letter before the porter locks up.
concepts.hook: Pell can scout as a cat and get the tack-room door open if the party watches the mews.

concepts.name: Rusk Brindle
concepts.motive: Find out what is moving between the sacks after the shop closes.
concepts.hook: Rusk will check the dark loft while the party keeps watch on the storekeeper.
